tagline: Stack crates into a tower of three on an orange pallet and keep it standing for five seconds, while a big red barrel is shoved down a lane to knock it over.
overview:
Skyline Stacker is a short first-person physics game on a rooftop. Ten crates in pastel colours stand in two rows; at the far end lies an orange pallet. Pick a crate up (E), carry it to the pallet and put it down, then bring another and set it on top. A tower of three crates that stays upright for five seconds wins.

The tower is judged by the engine's real physics: only crates still upright on the pallet count, so a stack that leans or topples scores nothing. You have 120 seconds. From the 50-second mark, every 25 seconds a big red barrel is shoved down the pink lane straight at the pallet at 10 m/s. Finish before it arrives, rebuild after it, or carry the barrel somewhere harmless first.
story: Up on a rooftop above a pastel city, a worker has two minutes to stack a little skyline of crates, and someone keeps rolling a heavy red barrel down the lane to knock it over.
goal: Build a tower of 3 upright crates on the orange pallet and keep it standing for 5 seconds before the 120-second clock runs out.
rules: Look at a crate and press E to pick it up; E again puts it down where you are looking (the crosshair turns green when something is in reach).
Only crates standing upright on the pallet count (STACKED). A crate on its side or off the pallet does not.
With 3 stacked, HOLD counts up; 5 seconds standing wins.
From 50 seconds in, and every 25 seconds after that, the red barrel is pushed down the pink lane at your tower.
You can pick the barrel up too, and park it out of the lane.

controls.action: Pick up / put down a crate (or the barrel)

characters.name: The Crates
characters.description: Ten pastel crates in two rows near the start.

characters.name: The Pallet
characters.description: The orange square at the far end of the rooftop.

characters.name: The Wrecking Barrel
characters.description: A big red barrel at the end of the pink lane. Every 25 seconds from the 50-second mark it is shoved at your tower.

tips: Drop each crate gently onto the middle of the one below: aim the crosshair at the top of the stack.
Three crates is the target for a reason: a fourth dropped from head height usually topples the tower.
Try to finish in the first 50 seconds, before the first barrel run.
The panel at the top left shows STACKED, HOLD and TIME_LEFT; WRECKER_IN counts the barrel runs.

gallery.caption: The rooftop from above: two rows of crates, the orange pallet, and the red barrel at the end of its lane.
The start, looking down the rooftop toward the pallet.
Two crates stacked on the pallet (STACKED 2).
The third crate lands crooked and knocks the stack over: BEST says 3 were up for a moment, STACKED is back to 1.
The crates lie scattered on the pallet. Stacking them straight is the whole game.

prompt: Please pull the most recent version of RedEngine. Create 3 mini games with this. The games must be unique and they must utilize physics in some way. Provide feedback per game about your experience developing with this engine.
prompt_source: Given to Claude Code on 2026-09-30, in a session working on RedEngine. That one prompt produced three games: Skyline Stacker, Castle Crash and Plate Chamber.
